description: post bridge lets you create, schedule and publish posts across 10 social platforms - X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads and Google Business - from one connected account. Ask ChatGPT to draft a caption, attach media, schedule a post across several platforms at once, or pull back views, likes and comments for posts you've published. It handles the platform-specific rules for you (media requirements, per-platform captions, scheduling times).

defaultPrompt: Write a post about bananas publish it to all my connected accounts on all platforms
Schedule this video to TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts for tomorrow at 9am.
Check which of my posts got the most views this month, and then give me ideas for similar posts i can make.
